latestVersion.changelog:
Seedance 2.0 Expert Cinema Director skill — initial public release:

- Supports high-fidelity text-to-video (t2v), image-to-video (i2v; up to 9 images), and seamless video extension with synchronized audio.
- Introduces "Director Brief" technical prompt format for professional results using cinematography and camera grammar.
- Enables multimodal referencing: style, motion, and rhythm locking via `@tag` system.
- Maintains character, environment, and clothing consistency for temporal coherence across all shots.
- Implements built-in guardrails for aspect ratio, duration, and quality; enforces technical prompting over keyword-based descriptions.
